# Modules

The Modules panel lists the modules loaded in the runtime. Each row shows the name, version, author, description and whether the module is enabled.

<!-- screenshot: modules.png generated by e2e -->
![The Modules panel](../assets/screenshots/modules.png)

It is on by default. Turn it off with `collectors.modules.enabled`.
